component.name: Aiddiction
component.summary: Projects and ACP agents on your own servers

description.p: Connects to an Aiddiction server — your workstation or a machine of your own — lists its projects, makes new ones empty, from a git repository or from a folder already there, and starts AI agents in them: Claude Code and Codex out of the box, any other agent that speaks the Agent Client Protocol by a command line.
The conversation with the agent — its answers, the tools it runs, the plan, and the permissions it asks for — follows you between the desktop and the phone.
